note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after a few searches for this part, so the rest was read directly from county, city, campaign and Wikipedia pages with the kit's fetcher; Ballotpedia answered the kit's fetcher with an empty page. Not found or left out: John Thurston's listed site (votejohnthurston.com, linked from Wikipedia's 2026 Treasurer page) fails the certificate check for its own name, so it could not be read and is not recorded. Christopher Olson: Wikipedia and Talk Business show a Christopher Olson as the Libertarian nominee for Secretary of State in 2018, but no page read ties that run to the 2026 Land Commissioner nominee by a second anchor, so it is left out. Mindy McAlindon's YouTube channel (on Wikipedia) is social media, not recorded. kennethferguson.com does not say which Kenneth Ferguson it is; aaronpilkington.com returned an empty page; kendramoore.com answered 403; richardmcgrew.com failed its certificate check; none recorded. Willie Leming's Lincoln alderman service and Kyle Lyons's and Becky Lewallen's first elections are reported in Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette articles behind a subscription wall, not used. No Arkansas party page calls anything an endorsement for these races (see ballot/lean/ar_endorsements.json). Brent Montgomery (House 52) is filed with the title 'Justice' but no page read says where he serves, so nothing is recorded.
